text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"Applying a periodic consolidation step (summarizing the accumulated context) to the current append‑based memory store will eliminate the observed QA accuracy drop that occurs once the store exceeds ~40 items.","confidence":0.78,"support_ids":["81d02abc","f1bc2caa","17d25ddc"],"tags":["memory","consolidation","interference","accuracy"]},{"statement":"Switching from a pure append strategy to a sliding‑window retrieval scheme (as explored in the ICLR ablation plan) will prevent the interference effect causing accuracy degradation beyond 40 stored items.","confidence":0.65,"support_ids":["7ed212c7","81d02abc","f1bc2caa"],"tags":["memory","window","append","ablation","interference"]}]}
